notes: Not approved and not published. The owner approves every post (npm run approve) after seeing the render and every caption.

Facts: GUIDED = "The coach calls every move and keeps time."; AT YOUR PACE = "The moves and a timer. Beeps, no coach voice." (data/loadoutMissions.js GUIDED_HELP / SOLO_HELP). ROUND appears when the mission has 2 or more rounds (a 10-minute mission has 2); a 1-round mission has FINISH only (soloFromGenerated tapHint). The clip must use 10 minutes or more.
The generated mission at your pace is a count-up circuit: rests are yours and the clock keeps counting, so the reel never says the timer "ends at N minutes".
The same moves run either way ("Runs exactly the workout on the card, GUIDED or AT YOUR PACE", START guide), which is why the card says "Same moves".
"Your pick is kept" is in the captions only: the START guide says the choice is kept for next time and START on Fit Mode and Home follows it.
qm-at-your-pace is the tightest clip (10 s for 4 uses): use its 0.0-2.4 (switch), 2.4-5.8 (moves and timer) and 6.2-9.2 (ROUND tap) stretches once and re-time to the real taps.
